start: Profile tab, 45 workouts over 3 months, the newest 'Pull 1' of 46 minutes with 5 exercises and 2 lifts that beat their best

steps.action: Open Profile and scroll to the feed
user_sees: Card: name, 'Saturday, 10 Oct 2026' style date, 'Pull 1', stats 'Time 46 min', 'Kg lifted 3,611', 'Records 2'
'3 sets Chin Up' style rows for the first 3 exercises, then 'See 2 more exercises'
must_not: Warm-up sets counted in the set rows

user_sees: The next 30 load; month lines keep their true totals
must_not: A month line counting only the loaded cards

start: Gym tab > leaderboard, a gym mate who turned on 'Let my gym mates see my workouts'

steps.action: Tap the mate's name ('Opens their workouts')
user_sees: Their page with initials, name, '<name> shares these workouts with members of your gym. You see the last 60 days.'
One card per workout: date, name, Time, Kg lifted, each exercise's best set
must_not: The mate's photo, body weight, notes or phone number
A share button or a way to open their sets

start: A bodyweight-only workout and a run in the feed

user_sees: The bodyweight workout shows 'Reps <n>' instead of Kg lifted

start: A new member with no workouts

user_sees: 'No workouts yet. Each one you finish shows here.'

steps.action: Open a mate who has stopped sharing (or hid their name, or left)
user_sees: 'This member is not sharing their workouts right now.'

steps.action: Open a mate with no internet
user_sees: "Couldn't load their workouts. Check your internet and try again." and 'Try again'

start: Member's own feed after editing and deleting workouts

steps.action: Delete a workout, come back to Profile
user_sees: The card gone and its month line one lower

steps.action: Edit a workout's exercises, come back
user_sees: The card shows the new sets and kg lifted
must_not: The old numbers on the card

steps.action: A mate turns sharing off, the member pulls down to refresh the mate's page
user_sees: 'This member is not sharing their workouts right now.'
must_not: The shared workouts still shown after the switch is off

start: Member A shares workouts; member B of the same gym and member C of another gym

steps.action: B opens A's profile from the leaderboard
user_sees: Up to 30 workouts from the last 60 days: name, date, time, kg lifted, best set
must_not: A's photos, body weight, notes or phone number

steps.action: A turns 'Let my gym mates see my workouts' off; B refreshes
user_sees: 'This member is not sharing their workouts right now.'
must_not: A's workouts still on the server for B

steps.action: C (another gym) tries to reach A's page
user_sees: Nothing of A (needs a second test gym to check)
